refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Machine is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
interface io.systemd.Machine
# The class of a machine type MachineClass( container, vm, host )
# What to send a signal to in a machine type KillWhom( leader, supervisor, all )
# A enum field allowing to gracefully get metadata type AcquireMetadata( # Do not include metadata in the output no, # Include metadata in the output yes, # Include metadata in the output, but gracefully eat up errors graceful )
# A enum field which defines way to open TTY for a machine type MachineOpenMode( # This mode allocates a pseudo TTY in the container and returns a file descriptor and its path. This is equivalent to transitioning into the container and invoking posix_openpt(3). tty, # This mode allocates a pseudo TTY in the container and ensures that a getty login prompt of the container is running on the other end. It returns the file descriptor of the PTY and the PTY path. This is useful for acquiring a pty with a login prompt from the container. login, # This mode allocates a pseudo TTY in the container, as the specified user, and invokes the executable at the specified path with a list of arguments (starting from argv[0]) and an environment block. It then returns the file descriptor of the PTY and the PTY path. shell )
# An object for referencing UNIX processes type ProcessId( # Numeric UNIX PID value pid: int, # 64bit inode number of pidfd if known pidfdId: ?int, # Boot ID of the system the inode number belongs to bootId: ?string )
# A timestamp object consisting of both CLOCK_REALTIME and CLOCK_MONOTONIC timestamps type Timestamp( # Timestamp in µs in the CLOCK_REALTIME clock (wallclock) realtime: ?int, # Timestamp in µs in the CLOCK_MONOTONIC clock monotonic: ?int )
# An address object type Address( ifindex: ?int, family: int, address: []int )
method Register( name: string, id: ?string, service: ?string, class: MachineClass, # The leader PID as simple positive integer. leader: ?int, # The leader PID as ProcessId structure. If both the leader and leaderProcessId parameters are specified they must reference the same process. Typically one would only specify one or the other however. It's generally recommended to specify leaderProcessId as it references a process in a robust way without risk of identifier recycling. leaderProcessId: ?ProcessId, # The supervisor PID as simple positive integer. Deprecated and ignored: the supervisor is now always derived from the caller's socket (kept for backward compatibility). supervisor: ?int, # The supervisor PID as ProcessId structure. Deprecated and ignored: the supervisor is now always derived from the caller's socket (kept for backward compatibility). supervisorProcessId: ?ProcessId, rootDirectory: ?string, ifIndices: ?[]int, vSockCid: ?int, sshAddress: ?string, sshPrivateKeyPath: ?string, # Varlink socket address for direct machine control. The server at this address is expected to implement io.systemd.MachineInstance and optionally io.systemd.VirtualMachineInstance. controlAddress: ?string, # Controls whether to allocate a scope unit for the machine to register. If false, the client already took care of that and registered a service/scope specific to the machine. allocateUnit: ?bool, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
method Unregister( # If non-null the name of a machine. name: ?string, # If non-null the PID of a machine. Special value 0 means to take pid of the machine the caller is part of. pid: ?ProcessId, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Terminate machine, killing its processes method Terminate( # If non-null the name of a machine. name: ?string, # If non-null the PID of a machine. Special value 0 means to take pid of the machine the caller is part of. pid: ?ProcessId, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Send a UNIX signal to the machine's processes method Kill( # If non-null the name of a machine. name: ?string, # If non-null the PID of a machine. Special value 0 means to take pid of the machine the caller is part of. pid: ?ProcessId, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Identifier that specifies what precisely to send the signal to (either 'leader', 'supervisor', or 'all'). whom: ?KillWhom, # Numeric UNIX signal integer. signal: int ) -> ()
# List running machines # [Supports 'more' flag] method List( # If non-null the name of a machine. name: ?string, # If non-null the PID of a machine. Special value 0 means to take pid of the machine the caller is part of. pid: ?ProcessId, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # If 'yes' the output will include machine metadata fields such as 'Addresses', 'OSRelease', and 'UIDShift'. If 'graceful' it's equal to true but gracefully eats up errors acquireMetadata: ?AcquireMetadata ) -> ( # Name of the machine name: string, # 128bit ID identifying this machine, formatted in hexadecimal id: ?string, # Name of the software that registered this machine service: ?string, # The class of this machine class: MachineClass, # Leader process PID of this machine leader: ?ProcessId, # Supervisor process PID of this machine supervisor: ?ProcessId, # Root directory of this machine, if known, relative to host file system rootDirectory: ?string, # The service manager unit this machine resides in unit: ?string, # Timestamp when the machine was activated timestamp: ?Timestamp, # AF_VSOCK CID of the machine if known and applicable vSockCid: ?int, # SSH address to connect to sshAddress: ?string, # Path to private SSH key sshPrivateKeyPath: ?string, # Varlink socket address for direct machine control, implementing io.systemd.MachineInstance and optionally further interfaces controlAddress: ?string, # List of addresses of the machine addresses: ?[]Address, # OS release information of the machine. It contains an array of key value pairs read from the os-release(5) file in the image. OSRelease: ?[]string, # Return the base UID/GID of the machine UIDShift: ?int, # Subcgroup path of the machine, relative to the unit's cgroup path subgroup: ?string, # Numeric UNIX UID of the user who registered the machine UID: ?int )
# Allocates a pseudo TTY in the container in various modes method Open( # If non-null the name of a machine. name: ?string, # If non-null the PID of a machine. Special value 0 means to take pid of the machine the caller is part of. pid: ?ProcessId, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # There are three possible values: 'tty', 'login', and 'shell'. Please see description for each of the modes. mode: MachineOpenMode, # See description of mode='shell'. Valid only when mode='shell' user: ?string, # See description of mode='shell'. Valid only when mode='shell' path: ?string, # See description of mode='shell'. Valid only when mode='shell' args: ?[]string, # See description of mode='shell'. Valid only when mode='shell' environment: ?[]string ) -> ( # File descriptor of the allocated pseudo TTY ptyFileDescriptor: int, # Path to the allocated pseudo TTY ptyPath: string )
# Maps given machine's UID/GID to host's UID/GID method MapFrom( # If non-null the name of a machine. name: ?string, # If non-null the PID of a machine. Special value 0 means to take pid of the machine the caller is part of. pid: ?ProcessId, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # UID in the machine to map to host UID uid: ?int, # GID in the machine to map to host GID gid: ?int ) -> ( # Mapped UID uid: ?int, # Mapped GID gid: ?int )
# Maps given host's UID/GID to a machine and corresponding UID/GID method MapTo( # Host UID to map to machine UID uid: ?int, # Host GID to map to machine GID gid: ?int ) -> ( # Mapped UID uid: ?int, # Mapped GID gid: ?int, # Machine's name which owns mapped UID/GID machineName: ?string )
# Bind mounts a file or directory from the host into the container method BindMount( # If non-null the name of a machine. name: ?string, # If non-null the PID of a machine. Special value 0 means to take pid of the machine the caller is part of. pid: ?ProcessId, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # The source directory/file on the host. The path must be absolute. source: string, # The destination directory/file in the container. The path must be absolute. If null, it's equal to 'source' destination: ?string, # If true, the bind mount shall be read-only readOnly: ?bool, # The destination mount point shall be created first, if it is missing mkdir: ?bool ) -> ()
# Copy files or directories from a container into the host method CopyFrom( # If non-null the name of a machine. name: ?string, # If non-null the PID of a machine. Special value 0 means to take pid of the machine the caller is part of. pid: ?ProcessId, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # The absolute path to source directory/file in the container source: string, # The absolute path to destination directory/file on the host. If null, it's equal to 'source'. destination: ?string, # If true the destination will be replaced replace: ?bool ) -> ()
# Copy files or directories from the host into a container method CopyTo( # If non-null the name of a machine. name: ?string, # If non-null the PID of a machine. Special value 0 means to take pid of the machine the caller is part of. pid: ?ProcessId, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # The absolute path to source directory/file on the host source: string, # The absolute path to destination directory/file in the container. If null, it's equal to 'source' destination: ?string, # If true the destination will be replaced replace: ?bool ) -> ()
# Opens machine's root directory method OpenRootDirectory( # If non-null the name of a machine. name: ?string, # If non-null the PID of a machine. Special value 0 means to take pid of the machine the caller is part of. pid: ?ProcessId, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( # File descriptor of opened root directory fileDescriptor: int )
# No matching machine currently running error NoSuchMachine()
error MachineExists()
# Machine does not use private networking error NoPrivateNetworking()
# Machine does not contain OS release information error NoOSReleaseInformation()
# Machine uses a complex UID/GID mapping, cannot determine shift error NoUIDShift()
# Requested information is not available error NotAvailable()
# Requested operation is not supported error NotSupported()
# There is no IPC service (such as system bus or varlink) in the container error NoIPC()
# No such user error NoSuchUser()
# No such group error NoSuchGroup()
# User belongs to host UID range error UserInHostRange()
# Group belongs to host GID range error GroupInHostRange()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Machine shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Machine.Register '{}' invokes its Register method.
